name: pagoda-ui
description: UI bundle sources: htmx + Alpine are bundled by `go tool esbuild` into public/static/js/app.js (single source of truth for versions); dynamic import()s are split into public/static/js/chunks/. Bun installs the packages (see `make bun-install`). The bundle is build output (gitignored), produced by `make js` locally and in the Docker build.
